# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus contains ~150 short call snippets, mostly WhatsApp voice-call transcriptions. After filtering out pure logistics/loading/driver-route chatter, internal payment-reconciliation calls, personal/family calls, and telemarketing cold-calls received BY Crayon, roughly 60-70 genuine sales-relevant exchanges remain — customer enquiries, rate negotiations, dealer/fabricator order routing, and stock/color availability checks. The sample is fragmented (many calls are single-topic, 20-40 seconds), so patterns below are drawn from repeated, consistent signals across multiple calls rather than one deep conversation. Crayon Roofing & Structures operates as a **JSW metal-roofing sheet distributor** based in Manali (Andarkuppam, Chennai), selling mainly over phone/WhatsApp to dealers, fabricators, and a few direct consumers, with supply-only fulfillment (no fixing/fabrication service).

## Products & brand ladder

Based only on what is mentioned in calls:

- **JSW Color On Plus** – premium line. AZ150 coating, 0.47mm/0.50mm/0.60mm thickness. Full color range available: "sky blue off white grey blue red எல்லாமே இருக்கும்" [sky blue, off white, grey, blue, red — all available]. 15-years warranty regardless of thickness ("2 thickness-ங்க சார் 2-க்குமே ஒரே year warranty தான்").
- **JSW Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** – budget line, AZ70 coating, 0.40–0.47mm. Limited colors only: "Pragathi-ல sky blue off white மட்டும் தான் இருக்கும்" [only sky blue and off-white in Pragathi]. Explicitly no grey, no brick red, no green in Pragathi stock.
- **JSW Indradhanush** – another budget-tier JSW product, 0.45mm AZ70, colors restricted to sky blue and half-white.
- **Radiance (Color On Plus variant)** – 0.60mm, two colors only (side/half white).
- **Silver On Plus / bare Galve (AZ150)** – plain/profile sheet sold by kg, ~₹101+GST/kg, 0.47mm.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** – sold by thickness (2mm mentioned), by the piece/length.
- **Decking sheets** – 0.8mm / 1mm / 1.2mm, used for flooring over structures (e.g., platform to hold a transformer, "1 ton weight இதுக்கு மேல வைக்கணும்").
- **PUFF insulated roof panels** – 50mm, top & bottom thickness specified separately, priced per sqm, loading extra.
- **Flashing / L-seat / ridge & crimp accessories** – custom length/fold work (e.g., "13 அடி... 12 அடி length 1 அடி crimp"), profile washers.
- **Tata Screws** – self-tapping/self-drilling, various sizes (1", 1.5", 2", 2.5", 3/4" stitch), single-thread vs double-thread variants, sold by "case/box" and by piece-rate for bulk.
- **Tata Welding Rods / Electrodes** – 2.5mm, 3.15mm, 4mm sizes; sold by "case" (box).
- **Cutting/Grinding wheels** (4-inch mentioned).
- **CO2 welding coil** – NOT stocked in-house; staff give a referral contact number instead.
- Explicitly **NOT offered**: UPVC/plastic sheet ("அது நம்ம பண்றது இல்லையே" — we don't make that), fabrication/fixing/installation services, barricade-type profiling is unclear/needs separate confirmation.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- JSW Color On Plus 0.47mm AZ150 — quoted at ₹435+GST/sqm, ₹445+GST/sqm, ₹430+GST/sqm, and ₹425+GST/sqm in different calls (price varies by customer/day — staff should always re-confirm current rate before quoting).
- JSW Color On Plus 0.50mm — ₹475+GST/sqm ("50 கலரான் + 15 years warranty வரும்").
- JSW Color On Plus 0.60mm AZ150 (15ft, sky blue) — ₹560+GST/sqm.
- JSW Indradhanush 0.45mm AZ70 — ₹375+GST/sqm or ₹370+tax/kg basis context; kg rate also quoted ~₹100+tax/kg.
- Plain/Silver On Plus sheet 0.47mm, 4ft width, 3.45m length — ₹101+GST/kg (also seen quoted at ₹100, ₹105, ₹117-120 by different staff/customers — inconsistency flagged in "Coaching Notes").
- Pragathi Plus 0.40mm — ₹105+GST/kg.
- PUFF roof panel 50mm — ₹1600+GST per sqm, loading extra, with top/bottom thickness mentioned separately in quotation.
- Cash & Carry vs Credit: standard rule stated repeatedly — "Cash and Carry-க்கு ₹100-ன்னா credit-க்கு ₹1 extra" [Cash & Carry ₹100, credit price is ₹1 more per kg]. Competing dealers were reportedly offering ₹98–98.50/kg, triggering internal "match or hold" discussions.
- Welding rod — ₹332–336 (incl. GST) for 2.5mm; an "offer price" of ₹270+GST was also cited before a stated price hike.
- Price hike pattern: "1st தேதி-ல இருந்து 10% ஏறுது" [from the 1st of
